# Infosys Pre-Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Coverage window: approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026. Items outside this window are labelled as background.*

## Executive Summary

Infosys's most material recent development is its Q2 FY27 results, released on 23 October 2026. Revenue and profit grew, headcount recovered, and large-deal bookings rose. However, management cut full-year FY27 constant-currency revenue growth guidance to 1–2% ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)). The company's workforce strategy is shifting toward specialist roles, AI-native fresher hiring, and outcome-based pricing ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). The provided sources contain no verified executive appointment, named product launch, or named deal announced within the 30-day window.

## Source Reliability and Scope

Not all supplied sources are suitable for a 30-day briefing. The table below records how each was weighted.

| [TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) (Times of India) | 29 Sep 2026 | Mainstream news, sourced from attendees | Background (outside window); strategy context |

## Material Changes in the Last 30 Days

### Financial Results and Guidance

Infosys reported Q2 FY27 results on 23 October 2026 ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)). Key figures are below.

| Metric | Q2 FY27 / Current | Comparison | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Net profit | ₹7,823 crore (+6% YoY) | ₹7,364 crore, Q2 FY26 | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| Revenue from operations | ₹49,244 crore (+11% YoY) | ₹44,490 crore, Q2 FY26 | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| Large-deal TCV | $5.2 billion | $3.6 billion, prior quarter | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| FY27 revenue growth guidance (cc) | 1–2% | Previously 1.5–3% | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| Operating margin guidance | 20–22% (maintained) | — | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |

The company attributed the guidance cut to cautious client spending in certain verticals. Stronger demand from energy and utilities clients and higher AI-services spending supported growth ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)).

### Workforce and Hiring

- Headcount reached 332,542 at the end of September 2026, a net addition of 4,480 employees in Q2 FY27. This followed a decline of 532 in Q1 FY27. The H1 FY27 net addition is 3,948 ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)).
- Fresher hiring has passed 8,000 so far in FY27 ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)).
- A YouTube headline reports "20K New Hires In FY27" ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FN4pRie-8Xo)). Unstop attributes a 20,000-fresher FY27 target to CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka, citing a Q4 FY26 net reduction of 8,440 ([Unstop, n.d.](https://unstop.com/blog/infosys-hiring-20000-freshers-fy27-guide)). These Q4 figures conflict with Livemint's Q1 FY27 figure of −532, so the Unstop numbers are treated as unverified.

### Deals

- Large-deal TCV of $5.2 billion in Q2 FY27 was up from $3.6 billion in the prior quarter ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)).
- Unstop cites a "$14.9 billion deal pipeline" ([Unstop, n.d.](https://unstop.com/blog/infosys-hiring-20000-freshers-fy27-guide)). This figure is undated and not corroborated, so it is excluded from the verified facts.
- No individually named client contracts appear in the provided sources for the window.

### Product and Strategy

- Infosys is emphasising outcome-based pricing and a model-agnostic strategy, and is working with open-weight models for enterprise customers who want more control over their data ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). This was reported from a September event, so it is background rather than a new in-window launch.
- Infosys Cobalt, described as the company's AI-powered cloud platform, was referenced at the same event ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

### Executive and Key Hires

- No executive appointment or key hire dated within the 30-day window appears in the provided sources. This is a gap in coverage, not confirmation that none occurred.
- CEO-designate Ashiss Kumar Dash shared the stage with incumbent CEO Salil Parekh at the Americas Confluence in Washington, DC ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). This event occurred in September, so it is background.

## Context Outside the 30-Day Window

### Specialist Workforce Plan (September 2026)

Infosys plans to move a quarter to a third of its workforce into specialist positions and to build a team of about 6,000 frontier engineers. More than 320,000 people work at the company, and 270,000 have received AI training, with 80,000 working on coding tools ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). Analysts cited in the same report said AI is pressuring headcount-based billing models ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

### U.S. Hiring Commitment (2020, Superseded)

Infosys's 2020 pledge to hire 12,000 U.S. workers over two years, part of a 25,000-job commitment over five years, is outdated ([Fujita, 2020](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/infosys-commits-to-hiring-12000-american-workers-expanding-us-footprint-130006173.html)). It should not be presented as a current commitment. It is useful only as evidence of the company's long-running U.S. localisation strategy.

## Analyst Assessment

My view is that the Q2 FY27 numbers show a company stabilising on headcount and margins while growing slowly. The main risk is top-line growth, not profitability.

1. **Growth is the binding constraint.** Revenue rose 11% in rupee terms in Q2, but full-year constant-currency guidance is only 1–2%. Rupee-reported growth is flattered by currency effects, so the gap between reported and constant-currency performance matters for interpreting the quarter.
2. **The bookings signal is positive but not conclusive.** A $5.2 billion large-deal TCV quarter, up from $3.6 billion, supports the view that demand is present. Still, TCV does not equal recognised revenue, and the guidance cut suggests conversion will be slow.
3. **The pyramid rebuild is a margin decision.** The 20,000 fresher target, the specialist shift, and the 6,000 frontier-engineer team all point to a lower-cost, AI-enabled delivery model. This supports the maintained 20–22% margin guidance, but it depends on AI productivity offsetting the revenue effect of moving away from billing by headcount.
4. **Leadership transition adds execution risk.** The CEO-designate was publicly introduced alongside the incumbent in September. The timing of a handover, and whether it changes strategy, is not stated in the sources.

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. How much of the 1–2% FY27 guidance reflects the transition from headcount-based to outcome-based contracts, and how much reflects client spending pullbacks in specific verticals? What share of the $5.2 billion Q2 TCV is priced on an outcome basis?
2. Given more than 8,000 fresher hires so far and a stated FY27 target of 20,000, how will fresher intake be balanced against reskilling for the specialist roles, and how will the 6,000 frontier-engineer team be sourced and funded?
3. What is the timeline for the CEO transition to Ashiss Kumar Dash, and are any changes planned to senior delivery or Americas leadership, including Anant Adya's role?
